notes.title: Pens: Ballad of the Erasers 40% off sale!
notes.content:
Today marks the release of [i]Pens: The Freeware Collection[/i] on Steam, joining [i]Pens: Ballad of the Erasers[/i] to ensure the entire [i]Pens[/i] storyline so far is avaiable on one platform. 

To celebrate this occasion, [i]Pens: Ballad of the Erasers[/i] is on sale for 40% off, from 11:30pm tonight (New Zealand time) for the next seven days! So, if you have (or have not) played through [i]The Freeware Collection[/i] and want to know what happens next, the price of entry into the [i]Pens'[/i] series first commercially available game is that much lower!

I hope you enjoy [i]The Freeware Collection[/i] and [i]Ballad of the Erasers[/i] as much as I have enjoyed making them and bringing them to you!

Christopher Robinson
HBGE
